      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds delayed broadcast with randomized jitter to mitigate timing-correlation tracking of transaction origin.     },

      "name": "rpc",

      "band": "P4",
      "score": 0.2,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Extends the `sendrawtransaction` method arguments without evidence of an external consumer request. Unsolicited RPC parameter additions rank low within the interface category."
    },

      "name": "tests",
